title: Approval receipt v1
description: NEW. Records that a human approved EXACTLY these bytes at this time. `approvedArtifactDigest` binds the approval to one immutable draft artifact. The Inbox send edge re-verifies this digest before sending; a bytes-mismatch is unclaimable. v1 (FROZEN): `signature` is OPTIONAL and NOT required for the edge to accept a request — acceptance rests on digest-binding + an authenticated channel + the edge's independent recipient re-verification against the ingested thread. Cryptographic signing (signer identity, signed canonical bytes, verification-key delivery as an opaque handle) is deferred to v2 alongside JobTrack's signed-receipt protocol. `signature`, when present, is an opaque attestation that grants no authority.

approvedArtifactDigest.description: Canonical SHA-256 of the EXACT approved bytes (rendered MIME or draft artifact). The send edge sends only bytes whose digest equals this.

scope.description: Approval authorizes a single send of these bytes to the locked recipient. No standing authority.

signature.description: Opaque out-of-band attestation over the canonical approval bytes. Never a credential; never confers send authority by itself.
